events.headline: UKRAINIAN DRONES STRIKE RUSSIA’S TUAPSE REFINERY FOR THIRD TIME
events.detail: Ukraine targeted a major Russian oil refinery in the Black Sea port city of Tuapse for the third time within two weeks.

events.headline: IS A US-IRAN DEAL STILL POSSIBLE?
events.detail: As the Strait of Hormuz stays largely shut and Washington sends mixed signals, talks run through Islamabad and Moscow.

events.headline: QATAR SAYS USING HORMUZ STRAIT AS POLITICAL WEAPON IS ‘UNACCEPTABLE’
events.detail: Qatar’s foreign ministry spokesman Majed al-Ansari said that the Strait of Hormuz must not be used as a bargaining chip.

events.headline: EMIRATOS ÁRABES UNIDOS SALE DE LA OPEP EN PLENA CRISIS POR EL CIERRE DE ORMUZ
events.detail: La decisión del quinto mayor exportador de petróleo del planeta dinamita el cartel, liderado por Arabia Saudí y en el que continúa Irán

events.headline: UAE LEAVES OPEC IN BLOW TO OIL CARTEL DURING WAR ON IRAN
events.detail: Announcement comes as Gulf producers are already struggling to ship exports through the Strait of Hormuz.

events.headline: RUSSIAN SUPERYACHT SAILS THROUGH STRAIT OF HORMUZ DESPITE BLOCKADE
events.detail: The 141m-long vessel, linked to a close ally of Russian President Vladimir Putin, cleared the waterway despite an ongoing blockade.
